7763993.sourceDescription: Serve up some Christmas fun with this exciting Gingerbread Man LEGO Minifigure keepsake ornament and make this the Christmas the sweetest yet. This ornament features a Gingerbread Man from the LEGO universe with a huge smile on his face and holding a red mug with the message 'Dunk me'! . Perfect for hanging on a Christmas tree, this decoration is made of hard-wearing plastic with a hanging loop and pre-threaded with white ribbon. . This is not a toy. For decorative use only. . Size H6.55, W3.1, D5cm.; Contains tree decoration.; Suitable for indoor use.; EAN:5054655688309.

xb9k30r0.variantName: Walplus 80 LED Lights Swirl Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 120 cm
xb9k30r0.sourceDescription: Create an extraordinary magical holiday ambience in your house with this swirl pre-lit Christmas tree! Swirl design: The artificial tree features a unique swirl design, making it an eye-catching centrepiece of your Christmas decorations.LED lights: The Xmas tree lights up beautifully and is decorated with multiple energy-efficient LED lights, creating a cosy holiday atmosphere.Different lighting effects: The LEDs are designed with 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade.PVC tips: This Christmas decoration includes multiple PVC tips, which provide a stunningly realistic look to the tree and give it a very bushy appearance too.Stable pot: The bottom pot provides the Christmas tree with optimal stability. Note:The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Colour: White LED colour: Warm white Material: PVC, steel Total height: 120 cm Bottom width: 65 cm Pot dimensions: 19 x 19 x 26 cm (L x W x H) Number of LEDs: 80 Power source: USB Power cable length: 2 m With USB With 364 tips With 8 light effects Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Pot This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

pq504ppx.baseName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Pre-Lit Cairngorm Pine Outdoor Potted Tree
pq504ppx.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Pre-Lit Cairngorm Pine Outdoor Potted Tree
pq504ppx.sourceDescription: Set the festive tone before guests enter your home with this elegant outdoor 4ft Christmas tree. Where to begin with the enchanting attributes of the Cairngorm Pine? First, there are the extremely realistic plastic-moulded branch tips which look stunning studded with warm white Christmas lights. Then, there is the traditional two-tone green far superior to the solid greens of many outdoor pre-lit Christmas trees. And let's not forget the attached hinged branches which make assembly so simple. Plus, we've thrown in some pretty plastic pinecones for good measure. It is Christmas, after all! Product Features • Size: 4ft • Pre-lit: 100 warm white LED lights (Mains-powered) • Number of branch tips: 196 PE branch tips • Tree width: 90cm diameter • Foliage colour: Two-tone green • Realistic look: 100% Ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Attractive base: Weighted black plastic pot • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor or Outdoor use: Designed for outdoor use • Height measured from the floor • Approximate cable length to tree is 5 metres • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

hfn0n8pq.variantName: Christmas Tree World 12ft Woodland Pine Hinged Branches Tree
hfn0n8pq.sourceDescription: One of our best-selling 12ft Christmas trees, the Woodland Pine has a "freshly cut" look. A bushy Christmas tree with stunning dark green foliage and a mix of PE & PVC branch tips, the Woodland Pine is a charming 12ft realistic Christmas tree that never fails to wow guests. And of course there are the strong, hinged branches that make this tall Xmas tree easy to put up and bring down. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 12ft • Number of branch tips: 8262 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 200cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
